positions.as_written: A repaired meniscus never looks normal, so imaging cannot declare it healed and should not be asked to.
State the interval since surgery and the repair technique if it is known.
Assess whether the meniscus is in position rather than whether the signal has resolved.
Assess for a displaced fragment, which is a positive finding.
Assess the implants and whether any has migrated.
Assess the cartilage of the same compartment.
